Create one exact scoped token-bucket-v1 policy from an already-identifiable request.

## Import

```ts

```

## Signature

```ts

	requestValue: unknown,
	opts: CreateTokenBucketRateLimitPolicyOptions,

```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `requestValue` | `unknown` | Complete strict request that establishes the exact scope. |
| `opts` | `CreateTokenBucketRateLimitPolicyOptions` | State revision, capacity, integer refill ratio, and initial units. |

## Returns
